# One module per case, xs-<case>.yang, with a must or when whose paths are
# followed through the schema (implemented with xs-base; xs-other is only imported).
# scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh and scripts/pyang-oracle.sh record what yanglint and
# pyang say about each; test/compile/xpath-schema.test.ts checks that @node-net/yang
# reports what is given here, and compares with both.
#   case  expected: ok or warning:<code>
ok-container            ok                              # relative, absolute and current() paths in containers
ok-list                 ok                              # list entries, with a predicate on the key
ok-choice               ok                              # paths step through choice and case
ok-augment              ok                              # an augment's when is evaluated from its target; names in the target need its prefix
ok-grouping             ok                              # a grouping used in two places, right in both
ok-rpc                  ok                              # RPC input and output see themselves and the datastore
ok-notification         ok                              # a notification sees its own content and the datastore
ok-action               ok                              # an action climbs to its list entry
ok-uses-when            ok                              # a when on uses or on a case is evaluated from the closest data ancestor
ok-state                ok                              # state data may refer to configuration
ok-axes                 ok                              # ancestor, descendant and self axes, and a union
ok-give-up              ok                              # deref(), wildcards, other axes and anydata: nothing to say
ok-no-cycle             ok                              # whens that depend on each other in a chain, not a cycle
ok-deviation            ok                              # a name a deviation removed is not reported
typo                    warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a misspelt name
typo-predicate          warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a misspelt name in a predicate
typo-absolute           warning:xpath-unknown-node      # an absolute path to a node that is not there
choice-name             warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a choice is not a data node
leaf-child              warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a leaf has no children
above-root              warning:xpath-unknown-node      # '..' above the root
descendant              warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a descendant that is not there
not-implemented         warning:xpath-not-implemented   # a module that is only imported has no data
state-from-config       warning:xpath-state-from-config # configuration cannot see state data
output-to-input         warning:xpath-unknown-node      # output cannot see input
action-typo             warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a misspelt name from inside an action
notification-uses-when  warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a when on uses in a notification starts from the notification, so '..' leaves it (RFC 6470's netconf-confirmed-commit)
augment-unprefixed      warning:xpath-unknown-node      # an unprefixed name is in the augmenting module, so the target's x needs its prefix (as in OpenConfig's gnsi modules)
grouping-one-place      warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a grouping that is right in one place and wrong in another
unquoted-literal        warning:xpath-unknown-node      # a literal written without quotes is a name (OpenConfig's bgp-policy in SR OS 26.10)
cycle-2                 warning:when-cycle              # two whens that depend on each other
cycle-3                 warning:when-cycle              # three whens in a cycle
cycle-ancestor          warning:when-cycle              # a cycle through the container above the node referred to
cycle-self              warning:when-cycle              # a when that refers to its own node
cycle-child             warning:when-cycle              # a when that refers to what is inside its node
cycle-case              warning:when-cycle              # a cycle through a case
